speaker: mother_skarrow
text: Forty winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.
renderText: <Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth.> 40 winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.
